request.note: No payload. The handler does not read `data`, so any payload (also `null`) works.

responses.name: Report
responses.when: Always, at once. It also works without a character and while a cave conversation pauses your instance.

fields.name: calls
fields.description: The call log of the socket for the last 4 s (`socket.calls`), oldest first. It includes this `ccreport` (cost 1 + 3).

fields.name: climit
fields.description: Always `limits.calls`: 200. A socket without a character has a limit of 50, but the report still says 200.

fields.name: total
fields.description: The number of events that the socket sent since it connected (`socket.total_calls`).

confirm.note: Each entry is `[new Date(), method, cost]`; both encoders send the `Date` as its ISO string (`toJSON`)
